content.introduction: The sources provide information on various global stock markets and indices as of today, October 2, 2026. The Nikkei 225 is up by 1,414.73 points to 66,896.00, the S&P/ASX 200 is up by 80.00 points to 8,789.30, and the Hang Seng is up by 79.43 points to 24,603.00. The sources also mention that the Asia-Pacific markets traded higher as investors assessed the U.S.-Iran peace deal diplomacy, and European stocks advanced with UK inflation and elevated bond yields in focus. The sources do not provide information on the exact current status of all indices or markets beyond these specific details.
